dz: 詹姆斯·弗朗西斯·爱德华·斯图亚特(英语:James Francis Edward Stuart),有时被称作"老伪装者",在他父亲詹姆斯二世去世后成为了英国和苏格兰王位上雅各派的求偿人.
de: James Francis Edward Stuart, sometimes called the "Old Pretender", becomes the Jacobite claimant to the thrones of England and Scotland on the death of his father, James II.
